Conjunction-only words fail the 95 percent gate on UD English-EWT (see PROVENANCE.md, Class Gate); the class is never a target of a trained model, but every word of the class stays in the dictionary and is an answer or a candidate

Interjection-only words fail the 95 percent gate on UD English-EWT (see PROVENANCE.md, Class Gate); the class is never a target of a trained model, but every word of the class stays in the dictionary and is an answer or a candidate
Determiners are a closed class of mostly single-sense words and a candidate sense of a few others; no model is trained for them, and every determiner of the dictionary stays in it
